0x001A08.en: 「Ufufu.../ I'll take you straight to heaven.」

0x001A55.en: 「Now, do as I say, little kitten.」

0x001A92.en: 「Ufufu... where do you feel it most, I wonder?」

0x001AD5.en: 「The only god for me/ is Lord Shu!」

0x001B22.en: 「Honestly, so persistent!/ I never want to see your face again,/ Louzorl!」

0x001BBB.en: 「Ufufu.../ Yang Long, let's do something fun~§」

0x001C0A.en: 「With you,/ I could have all kinds of fun, Yang Long.」

0x001C54.en: 「Now, Yang Long. Let's have some fun.」

0x001C8B.en: 「Ufufu.../ Looks like you'd be fun to tease.」

0x001CD5.en: 「Now, let's have fun.../ I'll teach you all sorts of things.」

0x001D22.en: 「Ufufu... I'll toy with you every which way.」

0x001D56.en: 「Now, it's time for a fun little party.」

0x001DBB.en: 「I love that look in your eyes. It gives me chills.」

0x001DFE.en: 「The feast's only just begun. Brace yourself.」

0x001E3E.en: 「I'll take you to a whole new world.」

0x001E7B.en: 「This weird god of ours-/ I'd like to cut ties soon.」

0x001FB9.en: 「Yes, yes, I'll finish you off quick.」

0x002027.en: 「Oh? You want me to tease you that badly?」

0x00205E.en: 「Ufufu... now it's my turn on top~§」

0x002091.en: 「Switching sides, now it's my turn to attack.」

0x0020C5.en: 「So, how do you want it?/ Go on, tell me?」

0x002112.en: 「I've got to give you a reward too.」

0x0022B1.en: 「Aah... I'm falling... I might just fall...」

0x002338.en: 「Ahn~§/ No, I'm going to lose it~§」

0x002377.en: 「Yes! That's it!/ A little more and I'll... aah...」

0x0023C1.en: 「Amazing... it's amazing, Yang Long~§/ No more, I'm... falling~§」

0x002483.en: 「Ah... mmh.../ Your technique's still too soft~§」

0x002512.en: 「Nnh~§/ Y-yes, that's it... keep it up...」

0x002558.en: 「So nice... that attack just now... love~ly~§」

0x002607.en: 「Ah... nice§/ Not bad at all, that one.」

0x00266B.en: 「Ahh§/ Yes, this, this!/ Good, Yang Long! Harder!」

0x00274C.en: 「No good, that's just not enough for me.」

0x002783.en: 「How clumsy.../ That's not enough to satisfy me.」

0x0027DF.en: 「That's your best? It's not working at all.」

0x00287B.en: 「Heh§/ Kind of weak, for Yang Long.」

0x002983.en: 「Hehe, you'll never/ catch me like that.」

0x0029CD.en: 「Now now, don't panic§/ I'm right here§」

0x002A03.en: 「If you want to hit me,/ get a little more serious.」

0x002AA3.en: 「Try harder - I won't let that hit me§」

0x002B01.en: 「My my, Yang Long, what's wrong?/ You've got to hit me, you know.」

0x002B76.en: 「Oh no, no weapons left. How troubling.」

0x002BB9.en: 「My my, from way over there.../ Come closer, why don't you.」

0x002C83.en: 「More, more,/ let me hear that sweet voice!」

0x002D0A.en: 「Looks like you need/ a bit more punishment.」

0x002DA4.en: 「Fine, I'll lend a hand,/ Yang Long.」

0x002E1C.en: 「You don't really need my help, do you?」

0x002E8A.en: 「Lord Shu, leave the rest to me!」

0x002EC4.en: 「Yes yes,/ I'll clean up the mess, Monica.」

0x002FB6.en: 「Me, covering for someone.../ Well, it looks fun, so why not.」

0x003015.en: 「Be grateful, I'm taking this for you.」

0x003058.en: 「They say kindness comes back around.../ So true§」

0x0030A7.en: 「Honestly,/ why do I have to cover for Masaki?」

0x00316F.en: 「Lune's shield, huh.../ I'd rather use you as mine.」

0x003205.en: 「Lord Shu!/ I'll take the blame... no,/ I'll take the attack!」

0x003265.en: 「...Truth is, I couldn't care/ less about you, though.」

0x003444.en: 「So, you want to die by my hand?」

0x0034E0.en: 「I won't kill you./ You're no fun once you're dead...」

0x003628.en: 「Fusing the elements to/ forge a new power...」

0x003672.en: 「But who cares how it works, right?」
